Define financial goals and reach them with scheduled deposits.

Last updated: 2026-10-24

Define the goal

A good goal has an amount and a deadline: “save for a trip within six months”.

Scheduled deposits

Split the goal into monthly deposits and schedule them in Cidna so it doesn’t depend on willpower.
